convention.transition_t: action a_t = (action_continuous[t], action_discrete[t]) is applied over the interval [sim_timestamp[t], sim_timestamp[t+1]]; reward[t], zone_info[t], ahu_info[t], boiler_info[t] describe transition t; tank_state[t+1] is the tank after transition t.
convention.obs_i: obs[0] is returned by env.reset(); obs[i] (i >= 1) is returned by env.step(a_{i-1}). obs has T+1 rows.
convention.obs_offset: For kind physical_state / action_echo / derived: the value of a field in obs[t + obs_offset] reflects transition t. For kind clock / exogenous: obs[i] reflects the wall-clock time sim_timestamp[i] (no transition index).
convention.decision_time: At decision t the policy has obs[0..t] and a[0..t-1]. A field with obs_offset d therefore reveals transition t-d at decision t: zone sensors (d=2) show transition t-2, echoes / flows / tank (d=1) show transition t-1.
convention.evidence_source: scratch/phase1_5/sensor_lag.py over data/phase1_sample (60 episodes, 6 buildings, 30 scenarios), offsets d in {-1,0,1,2}; plus simulator source (starter-kit, unmodified).

groups.name: zone_air_temperature
groups.mechanism: Vav.update_settings writes the sensor at the start of each step from the pre-step thermal field (simulator_flexible_floor_plan.execute_step_sim), so obs[t+1] shows the state before transition t and obs[t+2] the state after it.

groups.name: zone_heating_setpoint
groups.mechanism: set in Vav.update_settings from the schedule at the step start

groups.name: zone_cooling_setpoint
groups.mechanism: as heating setpoint

groups.name: num_occupants
groups.units: persons; obs = (N - c)/(c + 1) with c = meta.num_occupants_normalization_constant (0 in all shipped scenarios)
groups.mechanism: building.num_occupants averages occupancy over [now - 5 min, now]

groups.name: hws_supply_water_temperature
groups.mechanism: boiler tank temperature after HotWaterSystem.apply_heat_draw of transition t

groups.name: ahu_supply_air_flow
groups.privileged_match: sum over the AHU's zones of zone_info[t].air_flow_rate
groups.units: m3/s (native); 0 when the AHU is off
groups.mechanism: both fields read AirHandler.air_flow_rate, the summed VAV demand of transition t

groups.name: ahu_outside_air_flow
groups.privileged_match: (1 - clip(recirculation_cmd[t], 0, 0.7)) * ahu supply air flow of transition t
groups.mechanism: AirHandler.ambient_flow_rate

groups.name: outside_air_temperature
groups.mechanism: AirHandler.outside_air_temperature_sensor evaluates the weather at the observation timestamp; not stale. Checked on 6 scenarios (one per building) at k*300 s for k in -2..2: only k = 0 matches.

groups.name: clock_features
groups.privileged_match: calendar hour/minute/weekday of the reward start (= sim_timestamp[t+1] for obs[t+1])
groups.mechanism: environment._get_observation uses current_simulation_timestamp

groups.name: comfort_mode
groups.mechanism: environment._get_observation: building.is_comfort_mode(current_simulation_timestamp [+60 min]); no independent privileged counterpart logged

groups.name: ahu_sat_echo
groups.mechanism: AirHandler.supply_air_temperature_sensor returns the SETPOINT. It is NOT the delivered supply-air temperature (= min(mixed air, setpoint)), which is not observed.

groups.name: ahu_static_pressure_echo
groups.privileged_match: effective static pressure of a_t: run ? max(cmd, 200) : 0
groups.mechanism: AirHandler.supply_air_static_pressure_setpoint

groups.name: ahu_recirculation_echo
groups.privileged_match: effective recirculation of a_t: clip(cmd, 0, 0.7) (independent of run state)
groups.mechanism: AirHandler.recirculation setter clamps to [0, max_recirculation]

groups.name: ahu_run_echo
groups.mechanism: all three read AirHandler.run_command; supervisor and supply-fan fields verified on data, exhaust-fan field by source

groups.name: vav_damper_echo
groups.privileged_match: effective damper position of a_t: max(cmd, 0.1)
groups.mechanism: observable is Vav.damper_setting = max(command, min_damper_setting); the 0.1 floor never binds in the Phase 1 data (the baseline commands >= 0.1)

groups.name: vav_reheat_valve_echo
groups.mechanism: Vav.reheat_valve_setting = command

groups.name: hws_setpoint_echo
groups.privileged_match: HWS supply-temperature / differential-pressure command of a_t
groups.units: K / bar-equivalent (differential_pressure_setpoint obs is normalized, mean 10, std 6)
groups.mechanism: echo of the hot-water-system command

groups.name: hws_run_echo
groups.mechanism: run_status verified on data; supervisor_run_command verified in the Phase 1 echo check

groups.name: vav_max_flow
groups.mechanism: Vav.max_air_flow_rate: a static box parameter, NOT the delivered flow (zone_info.air_flow_rate is not observed per zone)

groups.name: ahu_fan_speed
groups.mechanism: source: AirHandler._air_flow_rate / max_air_flow_rate (NOT zeroed when the AHU is off). The offset is inferred from source only; max_air_flow_rate is not logged. Needs an instrumented rollout logging AirHandler internals to verify.

groups.name: request_counts
groups.mechanism: incremented per VAV demand inside the step (AirHandler.add_demand / HotWaterSystem); no privileged counterpart logged. Needs an instrumented rollout.
